annotations.title: Echo or space on the voice

description: Puts the voiceover in a space: "room" (Room), "slapback" (Slapback), "echo-throw" (Echo throw), "big-space" (Big space), or "none". Free and instant; it stacks on any voice effect and never moves a word. An echo throw echoes only chosen words (by default the last word before every real pause, and the last word): in a tight read an echo anywhere else lands on the next words and muddies them. Give throw_words (word indices from the take) to pick the words yourself, e.g. the hook's key word. The echo repeats on the music's half-beat when the film has music.

space.description: The space to put the voice in, or none to take it away

throw_words.description: Echo throw only: the indices of the words to echo (from the word timings)
